raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`docs/docs/sglang-diffusion/ring_sp_performance.mdx` tells users to pass `--sp-attention-mode kv_gather`, but the diffusion CLI has no such flag, so every K/V-gather example on the page fails at argument parsing. K/V gather is selected with `--kv-gather-degree` (see `python/sglang/multimodal_gen/runtime/server_args/server_args.py` and `docs/docs/sglang-diffusion/api/cli.mdx`). The page also predates the `sp_degree=2` auto-selection of K/V gather, so its "default is Ulysses" statements were wrong at SP2.

## Modifications

- Replace `--sp-attention-mode` with `--kv-gather-degree` in the controls list, the comparison table, and all three example commands (`--kv-gather-degree` equals `--sp-degree`, as `_validate_parallelism` requires).
- State the actual defaults: `sp_degree=2` picks K/V gather, higher SP degrees pick Ulysses; pass `--ulysses-degree` to keep Ulysses at SP2.
- State the real constraint from `_adjust_parallelism`: K/V gather does not compose with `--ulysses-degree` or `--ring-degree` (previously described as "`ring_degree=1`").

## Accuracy Tests

N/A (documentation only).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A (documentation only).

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). (N/A, docs only)
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (N/A)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

files.patch: @@ -10,19 +10,23 @@ Sequence parallelism splits long image or video latent sequences across GPUs. In - `--sp-degree`: total sequence parallel degree - `--ulysses-degree`: Ulysses parallel degree - `--ring-degree`: ring parallel degree -- `--sp-attention-mode`: attention exchange used inside each SP group +- `--kv-gather-degree`: K/V-gather degree, an alternative attention exchange + inside the SP group The degrees must satisfy: ```text sp_degree = ulysses_degree * ring_degree ``` -The default `--sp-attention-mode ulysses` uses all-to-all to redistribute -sequence shards over attention heads. `--sp-attention-mode kv_gather` keeps -queries sequence-sharded and all-gathers keys and values, then computes each -rank's local output directly. The K/V-gather mode currently supports -non-causal attention with `--ring-degree 1`. Varlen calls through the legacy +or, with K/V gather, `sp_degree = kv_gather_degree`. + +Ulysses uses all-to-all to redistribute sequence shards over attention heads. +K/V gather keeps queries sequence-sharded and all-gathers keys and values, then +computes each rank's local output directly. When no SP degree is set +explicitly, `sp_degree=2` defaults to K/V gather and higher SP degrees default +to Ulysses. K/V gather currently supports non-causal attention only and does +not compose with `--ulysses-degree` or `--ring-degree`. Varlen calls through the legacy `UlyssesAttention` adapter and video sparse attention are not supported. Use SP when sequence length or video shape makes the DiT forward pass the bottleneck and the model supports sequence sharding. For latency-oriented multi-GPU Qwen/Wan deployments, also compare against CFG parallelism and FSDP; SP is not automatically the best multi-GPU setting for every model. @@ -38,24 +42,24 @@ Use SP when sequence length or video shape makes the DiT forward pass the bottle - Mode + Flag Communication Memory Constraints - ulysses + --ulysses-degree All-to-all before and after attention Full sequence with a shard of the attention heads during attention Attention head divisibility must match the Ulysses degree - kv_gather + --kv-gather-degree All-gather K and V; Q and output remain sequence-sharded Replicates full K and V within the SP group - Non-causal attention and ring_degree=1; no legacy varlen or video sparse attention + Non-causal attention; does not compose with --ulysses-degree or --ring-degree; no legacy varlen or video sparse attention @@ -76,8 +80,9 @@ scaling makes the interconnect and input shape part of the selection policy. ### Ulysses Sequence Parallelism -The default mode needs only the total SP degree when ring parallelism is not -used: +At SP degrees above 2, Ulysses is the default and needs only the total SP +degree when ring parallelism is not used. At `sp_degree=2`, pass +`--ulysses-degree 2` to keep Ulysses instead of the K/V-gather default: ```bash sglang serve \ @@ -97,7 +102,7 @@ sglang serve \ --model-path Qwen/Qwen-Image \ --num-gpus 4 \ --sp-degree 4 \ - --sp-attention-mode kv_gather \ + --kv-gather-degree 4 \ --port 8898 ``` @@ -113,12 +118,12 @@ sglang serve \ --num-gpus 4 \ --tp-size 2 \ --sp-degree 2 \ - --sp-attention-mode kv_gather \ + --kv-gather-degree 2 \ --port 8898 ``` -Omit `--sp-attention-mode kv_gather` to use TP plus Ulysses with the same -`tp=2, sp=2` topology. +Replace `--kv-gather-degree 2` with `--ulysses-degree 2` to use TP plus Ulysses +with the same `tp=2, sp=2` topology. #### How TP Plus SP Works @@ -175,13 +180,13 @@ sglang serve \ --num-gpus 2 \ --use-fsdp-inference true \ --sp-degree 2 \ - --sp-attention-mode kv_gather \ + --kv-gather-degree 2 \ --port 8898 ``` FSDP adds weight all-gather communication, so compare it with pure SP when -both fit. K/V gather has the same non-causal and `ring_degree=1` constraints -under FSDP. +both fit. K/V gather has the same non-causal and no-Ulysses/no-ring +constraints under FSDP. ### Ring Sequence Parallelism
